g.text: Fits image px <-> robot XY homography and
a robot-space work plane for Z estimation.
The manager owns mutation validation and emits
group/pattern change signals after successful edits.
Pattern JSON is versioned via kSchemaVersion (= 2);
a document newer than that is refused rather than
loaded with partial defaults. Reads still accept the
two older gripper-geometry shapes -- see the note
Describes the GRIPPER: jaw size and spacing only, so
it is shareable as a named preset (GripperPresetStore).
The jaw ORIENTATION is per-pattern and therefore lives
v1 nested gripperBoxes { w, h, distance, angle }
v2 nested gripperBoxes { w, h, distance }
One read rule covers all three: take the angle from
gripperBoxes.angle when present (v1), else from the
flat pickingBoxAngle key (v0 and v2 share it).
This back-compatible READ is a deliberate, agreed
exception to the no-compat-shims rule in AGENT.md --
real commissioned picking geometry exists in saved
Project-scoped: owned by TaskLocalization and saved
under its "gripperPresets" key, so presets travel with
the project rather than the machine.
Applying a preset COPIES its values into the pattern's
own m_gripperBoxes. Nothing holds a reference, so
editing or deleting a preset later cannot mutate a
pattern already authored from it -- which is what keeps
a commissioned task stable when the list is tidied up.
Lives in model, not matching: matching never reads
Not to be confused with GripperBoxes: this is the
per-match geometry derived from it, and with
ItemGripperBox, an unrelated QGraphicsItem in the ui
